scores.transition_note: Transitions for the tested radial→radial scenarios appear visually stable — no offscreen flight, origin clustering, or size instability detected in filmstrips, and programmatic checks all pass. However, the code calls nodeLayer.selectAll('*').remove() before every render, destroying the DOM and bypassing D3's keyed update/exit transitions, so nodes snap to their new positions on enter rather than interpolating from prior positions; the stored _prev_cx/_prev_cy values are never used for enter interpolation. This means cross-layout transitions (e.g., radial to treemap or sunburst) would produce instant appearance rather than smooth morphing, though that was not captured in the tested filmstrips.
scores.visual_critic_note: Dark theme and schemeTableau10 palette give it visual coherence, but the radial layout crowds labels at the bottom arc and the control bar uses flat default styling with no typographic hierarchy between labels and values.
